project.name: Supir-Vast :: vastir-vulkan
project.description: The stack's one Panama binding to Vulkan: the loader, instance, device, debug messenger and the struct layouts they share. Hand-written over vastir-ffi, with no windowing and no rendering — a window system hands it the instance extensions it needs, and whatever draws or computes does so on the device this creates. One binding and one device are what let a simulation and a renderer share a buffer.
